overview.description: The Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF (JHAI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed, high-conviction portfolio focused on companies that are reshaping their business models with artificial intelligence and appear to be positioned to benefit from the development of this technology.n. JHAI was launched on Aug 19, 2025 and is issued by Janus Henderson.
